build.buildCommand: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-scripts && rm -f bootstrap/cache/packages.php bootstrap/cache/services.php && npm ci && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: mkdir -p storage/framework/sessions storage/framework/views storage/framework/cache && chmod -R 777 storage bootstrap/cache && rm -f bootstrap/cache/packages.php bootstrap/cache/services.php && [ -z "$APP_KEY" ] && php artisan key:generate --force; [ -n "$DB_HOST" ] || export DB_HOST=${MYSQLHOST:-127.0.0.1}; [ -n "$DB_PORT" ] || export DB_PORT=${MYSQLPORT:-3306}; [ -n "$DB_DATABASE" ] || export DB_DATABASE=${MYSQLDATABASE:-ongrail}; [ -n "$DB_USERNAME" ] || export DB_USERNAME=${MYSQLUSER:-root}; [ -n "$DB_PASSWORD" ] || export DB_PASSWORD=${MYSQLPASSWORD:-}; php artisan migrate --force && php bin/seed-once.php && node /assets/scripts/prestart.mjs /app/nginx.template.conf /nginx.conf && (php-fpm -y /assets/php-fpm.conf & nginx -c /nginx.conf)
